crop.notes: Whole item; top of the crop shows part of the masthead date.

ocr.notes: Column rule runs through the left edge, so many line starts are garbled, but names and facts are recoverable.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that a Franklin County sheriff arrested Tom Allen at his saloon on warrants over the Flint-McManus prize fight; he gave $500 bond to appear at Union the next morning.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, April 19, 1888, page 5.

facts.fact: Sheriff Oscar Ehlers of Franklin County arrested Allen at his St. Louis saloon on a warrant for aiding and abetting the Flint-McManus prize fight; his bond was set at $500
The arrested sports left St. Louis by train for a preliminary hearing before Justice Frazee at Union, Franklin County

notes: The article says 'the sports' left on the same train as the sheriff, without naming Allen; expected to waive examination.
